scope: Scratch-only experiment retaining the selected AC1018 planar MLINE group-41 profile through LibreCAD headless import and unchanged AC1018 ASCII export. No patch is released and no drawing is committed.

inputs.profile: One open, top-justified, six-vertex, two-element planar MLINE; scale=1, style STANDARD, unit miters, group-41 pairs [distance,0], empty group-42, no MLINE XDATA. Scope and per-vertex signed values are detailed in the reference receipt.

prototype.consumerBase: LibreCAD scratch checkout d9c0ae435ed5892611d6bec3c628033004dbcaf4 with the independently reviewed deferred-style and closure scratch candidates applied
prototype.isolation: Compiled only the prototype filter object using existing consumer librecad_lib compiler flags and replaced its member in a private copy of the matching closure archive; prototype header matches the closure header so no class layout changes are introduced. The normal shared archive was not modified.
prototype.sketch: For one bounded late-style DXF profile, retain per-vertex direction and one two-value group-41 list per vertex and element. Emit per-vertex geometry using the first signed 41 without reapplying scale. Encode a separate LibreCAD_MLINE_V2 marker; validate fixed counts and fields for this profile and reconstruct group-41 pairs and directions only on AC1018 DXF export.
prototype.scopeLimitation: The implementation is advisory and intentionally not a proposed or released patch; the safety and edit/identity cases listed below are unresolved.

tested.saveResults: Each command returned 0; each imported two polylines, wrote AC1018 ASCII DXF, and fresh LibreCAD import returned two polylines. Both logs report a duplicate source handle shared by the projected entities, so reference behavior must not be inferred from the success status.
tested.comparison: Both fresh outputs contain exactly one MLINE with flags 1, no XDATA, scale 1, top justification and a group-340 reference resolving to the STANDARD MLINESTYLE with flags 0 and offsets +0.5/-0.5. All six vertex positions, six segment directions, six miter directions, 12 group-41 pairs and empty group-42 lists agree within the comparison tolerance 1e-12. Both fresh output byte hashes are b51962d2010d6246702ec77a8a6376b6d87119d3176969eb89a0f40bb317655f.
tested.precisionLimit: The existing ASCII writer changes some binary64 values by a few ULP. These outputs are tolerance-matched, not bit-exact. No global formatter was changed.
tested.compiledGuardStatus: The exact source and object hashes above include finite projected-coordinate, bounded V2 list parsing, and V2-to-V1 extra-field refusal changes. The two positive cases were rerun after those changes. No negative corruption, overflow, downgrade, style-edit or retry control was run for this prototype; static guards are not reported as tested.

independentReviewBlockers: Prove that the unique unchanged MLINESTYLE is the actual provider emitted by DXF, including raw/typed deduplication, style edits/deletion/duplicates, handle collision and remap; the one positive output does not establish that proof.
Require a source-backed direction/miter relationship and nondegenerate baseline; reject malformed zero/wrong directions, duplicate vertices, overflow and invalid topology with focused controls.

Before collapsing siblings into an MLINE, validate matching layer/pen/visibility and individually linear, finite, continuous segment endpoints. An edited sibling, arc replacing a segment or disconnected segment must remain visible fallback or strict refusal.

The input guard checks MLINE XDATA emptiness but does not yet prove absence or safe retention of arbitrary appData, reactors, extension dictionary/common references, owner/space state, or duplicated source-handle remaps. Source XDATA on other profiles is outside this screen.

Exercise V2 marker tampering/downgrade, extra unrelated APPID/XDATA, mismatched versions and unsupported targets, old v1 compatibility, import/save/reopen, seeded-destination safety and corrected same-filter retry. Verify fallback really retains unrelated data and registers APPID.

This selected profile has no cuts, fill or native caps and default 2D plane. Do not widen to 3D, non-default/negative scale, cuts, fills, transformed/cloned/edited sidecars or general versions without independent semantic and native evidence.
next: Keep this prototype outside the release tree. First add focused negative tests for the four identity/topology/presentation/common-reference blockers and define a unique style-provider/remap invariant that can be checked on the actual output path; only integrate once each passes along with ASCII/Binary import, save/readback, refusal/retry and the stated precision policy.
limits: The independent comparison measures structured serialized fields, not native AutoCAD interpretation or GUI rendering.
The local scratch paths are ephemeral. No external drawing fixture was added and no support claim was promoted.
